綠龍Green Dragon

    作爲最狡詐叛逆的真龍，綠龍時常以誤導和詭詐手段讓自己在敵人面前取得先手。它們脾氣暴躁且極度邪惡，特別喜歡顛覆腐化善良之心。綠龍漫遊於遠古森林，它們爲爭奪領地而引起爭端，更是常常因爭權奪利而錙銖必較。
    綠龍爲人所知的形象包括彎曲的下頜輪廓，以及從眉間開始長出，延伸至脊背並在顱後達到最高的棘冠。綠龍沒有外耳，反而長着兩排由棘刺支撐的皮質扁平鱗板，並沿着脖子一直延伸到身軀。
    綠龍雛龍那輕薄鱗片的色調是暗淡近黑的墨綠色。隨着年齡增長，綠龍的鱗片變大增厚，並變得泛起森綠、翠綠和橄欖綠等色調，以助其融入林木繁茂的環境中。其翅膀上長着斑駁的紋理，在靠近前緣的地方爲暗色調而接近後緣的地方爲亮色調。
    綠龍的四肢對身體的比例比其他龍類更修長，因而其步行時可以輕易越過灌木叢和其他的林中雜物。同時，年長綠龍的修長脖子也使其得以抬頭便與樹頂齊高。

    任性獵手Capricious Hunters。綠龍巡視其森林領地的天空與大地，並在其中狩獵捕食。它們能嚥下遇到的任何生物，必要時還會吞食樹叢與嫩枝，但其最愛的獵物始終還是精靈。

    綠龍是完美的騙子，也是故弄玄虛的演講大師。它們喜歡恐嚇低等生物，而與其他龍類打交道時則會採用更加隱蔽的手段從中操控。綠龍在未受挑釁前便會主動攻擊其他動物和怪物，尤其是涉及到其領地潛在威脅時更甚。綠龍與知性生物打交道時，其表現出的權力慾足以媲美其它龍族的貪財欲，而它們也總是在尋找能夠輔助其雄心的生物。
    綠龍發動襲擊前會先擬定計劃，有時還會持續數日的尾隨目標。如果目標較弱小，綠龍便喜歡在攻擊前以外表恐嚇對方。它們從不殺死所有敵人，而是更喜歡以恐嚇對倖存者實施操控。它們會細心研究領地附近生物的能力習性，並掌握附近所有的寶藏的位置。綠龍偶爾會在對方支付贖金後釋放囚犯。此外，那些無法爲綠龍日常生活貢獻價值的生物則必死無疑。

    幕後黑手Manipulative Schemers。綠龍生性狡詐而心思縝密，且會以估測並揭示其他生物最深慾望的方式使對方屈從於自己。那些意圖制服綠龍的愚者最終都會意識到，自己自以爲在享受綠龍服務時，其實對方單純是在評估自己的斤兩。
    操縱其他生物時的綠龍既能言善道又圓滑世故。而在同類之間，則顯得招搖而粗野。尤其是那些年齡與地位相當的綠龍間交流時更是如此。

    紛爭與腐化Conflict and Corruption。綠龍的森林領地與其他地形有交叉時，常常會與其中的其他龍類發生衝突。這時綠龍往往會假裝退縮，然後蟄伏等待機會（有時會長達數十年），直至將對手殺死並將其寶庫和巢穴據爲己有。
    綠龍會接受類地精goblinoids、伊特怪ettercaps、雙頭巨人ettins、狗頭人kobolds、獸人orc和蛇人yuan-ti等知性生物作爲其奴僕。它們會讓精靈們隨其意志而墮落或屈從並以此取樂。綠龍有時會以恐懼將手下的心智扭曲至瘋狂邊緣，而遍佈整個森林的迷霧也正反映着折磨這些奴才的夢境。
    活體財寶Living Treasures。綠龍最愛的財寶便是那些屈從於其意志的知性生物，其中包括各種特定人物如某受愛戴英雄，某知名智者或是某著名吟遊詩人。而其最愛的物質財寶當屬翡翠、木雕、樂器和以類人生物爲主題的雕塑。

“我看見一名遠古的精靈之王。王權早已逝去的他半夢半醒的倒在其王座上。一頭綠龍正在王的耳邊低語，扭曲腐化着王的夢境。這條龍名叫湛青血禍Cyan Bloodbane，而它，將爲我們所有人帶來毀滅。”

西瓦納斯提精靈Silvanesti的先知，

亞苟斯的帕里歐斯Pelios of Ergoth

綠龍巢穴A Green Dragon’s Lair

喜好森林的綠龍有時會與沼澤叢林中的黑龍和極地針葉林中的白龍爭奪領地。受綠龍控制的森林不難識別。一條傳奇綠龍所在的森林空氣中永遠瀰漫着濃霧，其刺鼻的氣味還會讓其內呼吸的生物中毒。覆蓋着苔蘚的樹木密不透風的糾纏在一起，使得道路如迷宮般曲折通向森林的腹地。光線透過樹林照到森林的地面，呈現出一片翠綠的色調，連其內的每一聲聲響都顯得模糊不清。

在其森林中央，綠龍會選一個峭壁或山坡上的洞穴作巢穴，再把入口隱藏起來以避人耳目。還有一些會尋找隱藏在瀑布後的洞口，或是要穿過湖底或溪底才能到達的半淹洞穴。還有些會以植被遮蔽其巢穴的入口。

色彩龍Chromatic Dragons

    

黑龍、藍龍、綠龍、紅龍和白龍代表着龍類邪惡方勢力。好鬥、貪婪、自負的色彩龍是黑暗賢者或強大暴君，以恐懼壓迫衆生——包括它們的同類。

    貪婪爲動力Driven by Greed。色彩龍迷戀財寶，這種貪婪本質會貫徹它們的每項計劃和陰謀中。它們認爲自己有權佔有世界上所有的財富，因此色彩龍抓獲這些被類人或其他生物“偷”走的財寶時無需半點遲疑。這些成堆的錢幣、耀眼的寶石和魔法裝備，即是傳說中的巨龍寶庫。此外，色彩龍對商務活動毫無興趣，其積累財富單純是爲了擁有而並非爲了其他。

    自負的生物Creatures of Ego。色彩龍們一致承認自身族類的優越性，相信自己是凡間生物中的至高志強者。與其他生物互動時，它們也只關注自身利益的得失。色彩龍們堅信自己具有與生俱來的統治權，而這種信念正是其世界觀的基石。讓色彩龍謙虛就如同說服風停止吹動。在它們看來，類人生物只是動物，只適合作爲獵物和馱獸且完全不值得尊重。

    危險的巢穴Dangerous Lairs。龍的巢穴相當去其權利的寶座，也是其儲存財寶的寶庫。雖然龍類可以憑着其天生的耐性與韌性承受各種惡劣環境效應，但它們還是築起巢穴以作防守而非安居。此外，這些巢穴都會設置多個出入口，其內還爲其寶庫設置了安保措施。
    色彩龍的巢穴大多建在危險的偏遠地區，以防止那些最大膽的凡人前來拜訪。黑龍會將巢穴建在一片廣闊沼澤中央，而紅龍則可能佔據活火山的噴發口作其巢穴。除依靠大自然防禦巢穴外，一些強大的色彩龍還會使用魔法守衛、陷阱和其他順從的生物作爲巢穴的護衛。

    惡龍女王Queen of Evil Dragons。龍後提亞馬特Tiamat the Dragon Queen是邪惡龍 類的主神。她定居於九層地獄的第一層阿佛納斯Avernus中。作爲一名弱等神力，提亞馬特可以授予其崇拜者法術，只是她並不喜歡分享自己的力量。她是所有惡龍貪婪的集合體，自認爲多元宇宙和其中所有的寶藏終有一天都將成爲她獨享的所有物。
    提亞馬特是一頭體型龐大的巨龍。它的五顆頭顱反映了崇拜她的色彩龍——黑龍、藍龍、綠龍、紅龍和白龍。她的五種吐息武器可以消滅一整支軍隊，加上其可怕的施法能力以及駭人的龍爪使其成爲戰場上的恐懼之源。
    提亞馬特最痛恨的敵人，鉑金龍巴哈姆特Bahamut the Platinum Dragon，同時也是與她分享所有龍類信仰的存在。另外，她也保留着對阿斯蒙蒂斯Asmodeus的特殊恨意——後者在很久之前，爲了限制龍後的力量而剝奪了她對阿佛納斯的統治權。
龍Dragons

    真龍是擁有古老血統和驚人力量的有翼爬行類。它們以狡詐貪婪的掠奪者形象而威名遠揚，而最古老的龍也可以作爲其所在世界最強大的生物。龍類還包含了其他一些天生具有強大力量，可以使用恐怖吐息武器或其它超自然能力的魔法生物。
    許多生物（包括飛龍wyverns和龍龜dragon turtles）都擁有龍族血統。而真龍則只包括金屬龍和色彩龍兩大類別。黑龍、藍龍、綠龍、紅龍和白龍全都自私邪惡，而又令人恐懼。黃銅龍、青銅龍、赤銅龍、金龍和銀龍則體現着高貴與善良，而且睿智又令人敬畏。
    儘管它們的目標和理想千差萬別，但所有的真龍都貪戀財富，會收集成堆的錢幣並收集寶石、首飾和魔法道具。囤積了大量財寶的龍不大部分時間都呆在其寶庫中，而只有在巡視和覓食時纔會走出其巢穴。
    真龍的整個生命週期貫穿其四個不同的年齡階段，一條龍從弱小的雛龍到遠古龍可以存活長達一千年。在此期間，它們的實力將逐漸變得無可匹敵，而其財富也會超值增長。

巢穴動作Lair Actions

    先攻輪到20時（出現等值時視爲後手），該龍可執行一個巢穴動作併產生下列效應其一。它不能在連續兩輪裏重複使用同一種效應：

綠龍周邊120尺範圍內它能看見的一點長出糾纏的根鬚和藤蔓，並覆蓋以該點爲中心半徑20尺的區域。該區域變成困難地形，其中的每個生物都必須進行一次DC 15的力量豁免，豁免失敗者將受根鬚和藤蔓束縛。任一生物（包括被束縛者本身）都可以用一個動作進行一次DC 15的力量豁免以解脫束縛。這條龍再此使用該巢穴動作，或其死亡時這些根鬚與藤蔓便開始枯萎消失。

綠龍周邊120尺範圍內一處固態表面出現一面由帶刺荊棘糾纏而成的牆壁。該牆至多長60尺、高10尺、厚5尺，且可以遮擋視線。這面牆出現時，任何處於其區域內的生物都必須進行一次DC 15的敏捷豁免。豁免失敗者將受到18（4d8）點穿刺傷害，並被往牆外推出5尺落在牆壁的某一邊（由其自選）。生物可以緩慢而痛苦的以移動方式穿過該牆壁。生物在牆內每移動1尺必須花費4尺的移動力。此外，身處牆壁內的生物如果接觸到牆壁，則其每輪必須進行一次DC 15的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到18（4d8）點穿刺傷害，豁免成功則傷害減半。每10尺長的一段牆擁有AC 5，HP 15，火焰傷害易傷，鈍擊和穿刺傷害抗性，並且免疫心靈傷害。這條龍再此使用該巢穴動作，或其死亡時這面牆便會縮回到地面之下。

綠龍周邊120尺範圍內一個它能看見的生物周圍升起魔法的濃霧。該生物必須進行一次DC 15的感知豁免，豁免失敗則被該龍魅惑，效應持續至下一輪先攻輪到20。

取決於您的意願，一條傳奇（成年或遠古）綠龍可以在其巢穴內使用以下一種或多種巢穴動作：

蹣跚藤蔓Creeper Vines。綠龍用藤蔓和根鬚將其巢穴內的最多三具類人屍骨活化爲殭屍Zombie。這些殭屍們會在本巢穴動作之後立即行動。在1分鐘後，或是龍再度使用這個巢穴動作時，或是殭屍被消滅時，每個殭屍都將恢復爲無生命的屍體。

枝幹抽打Lashing Root。巢穴內一處大型樹根或枝條對其10尺內的單一生物進行近戰攻擊。其具有+7的命中加值，並造成10（3d6）鈍擊傷害。如果目標生物的體型爲中等或更小，則必須成功通過一次DC15的力量豁免，否則受擊倒地。

區域效應Regional Effects

    這片區域由於其內一個傳奇綠龍的巢穴而被魔法扭曲，造成了下列一項或多項的效應：

巢穴周邊1裏範圍內的樹叢形成了迷宮式的通道。此樹叢視爲10尺高、10尺厚，且能遮擋視線的牆壁。生物可以移動穿過該樹叢，其每移動1尺將花費4尺移動力。身處該樹叢內的生物如果接觸到樹叢，則每輪必須進行一次DC 15的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到3（1d6）點穿刺傷害。
  每10尺長的一段樹叢擁有AC 5，HP 30，鈍擊和穿刺傷害抗性，並且免疫心靈和雷鳴傷害。

綠龍可以在其巢穴周邊1裏範圍內，以自己意願選擇是否不帶任何物理痕跡的通過某個地點。除魔法以外的任何手段都無法追蹤到以此方式匿蹤的龍。此外，它還可以無視該區域內非魔法非生物的植物所造成的移動障礙和傷害，包括上述樹叢。這些植物會在該龍經過時自行避讓。

巢穴周圍1裏範圍內的齧齒動物和鳥類都可以充當龍的耳目。在區域內，大體型的獵物（比如鹿）十分稀少，暗示着飢餓的非自然捕食者正存在附近。

    龍死亡後，這些齧齒動物和鳥類將失去它們的超自然鏈接。樹叢得以保留着，不過會在1d10日內逐漸變爲普通植物和正常的困難地形，並失去棘刺。

作爲《怪物圖鑑》所描述效應的追加或替代，以下這些效應中的一個或兩個都可能出現在綠龍巢穴周圍的區域：

邀人低語Inviting Whispers。綠龍巢穴周圍1英里範圍內的樹葉都會傳來陣陣低語聲。這些低語聽不清楚，但任何智力爲5或以上的生物都會將其解釋爲在邀請他們深入綠植之中。

異化信使Twisted Messengers。龍可以使其巢穴周圍1英里範圍內的任何小型野獸變成它的喉舌。如同字面意義將該生物的喉嚨與嘴巴扭曲成龍的怪異樣子，好發出龍的聲音。

定製龍類Customizing Dragons FTD p33

正如《地下城主指南》中所說，你可以定製任何龍的數據以反映龍的獨特能力。像下面這樣的小改動是很容易做到的，而且對龍的挑戰等級沒有影響。

語言Laanguages。大多數龍喜歡說龍語，但爲了與盟友和僕從打交道同樣也需要學習通用語。鑑於龍的高智力和長壽命，它們可以很容易地學習其他語言。你可以將一些額外語言添加到龍的資料卡中。

技能Skills。大多數龍都具有察覺和隱匿技能的熟練項，許多龍還有額外的技能熟練。和語言一樣，你可以定製龍的技能列表（甚至將他們對某些技能的熟練翻倍）以反映其特殊的興趣和技巧。你也可以給龍提供工具熟練，特別是當龍在人形狀態下花費了一段時間訓練時。

法術Spells。《怪物圖鑑》中關於讓龍成爲天生的施法者的變體規則是一種簡單的方法，可以在不影響龍的挑戰等級的情況下爲其增加多樣性。第5章爲不同種類的龍提供了建議的法術列表，但你也可以選擇法術來反映龍的特性。一條天生施展德魯伊法術的龍與施展術士法術的龍給人的感覺會截然不同。你也可以給龍提供比這個變體規則所允許的更高等級的法術，但這樣的調整可能會增加龍的挑戰等級——尤其是當這些法術能直接對目標造成傷害或施加各類增益/減益時。

其他特質和動作Other Traits and Actions。你可以借用其他怪物的特性和行動來爲龍增加獨特的風味。考慮一下這些例子。

變形Change Shape。你可以決定讓龍在比平時更小的年齡獲得這個動作，特別是想在你的戰役中靠類人形態來塑造龍類時。本章後面的 "變形 "部分提供了更多信息和靈感。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的金屬龍Metallic Dragons）。)

傷害吸收Damage Absorption。你也許會令紅龍或金龍不僅不受火焰傷害，甚至還能被烈焰治癒。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的肉身魔像Flesh Golem）。)

飛掠Flyby。龍那超凡的飛行技巧使其能迅速飛出敵人的威脅範圍。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的鹿鷹獸peryton）。)

擬聲Mimicry。對狡猾的龍來說，模仿冒險者或他們的盟友可能是一個有趣並且的確有用的技巧。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的天狗Kenku）。)

復生Rejuvenation。在你的戰役中，你可能會將作爲物質位面重要組分的龍類設定爲幾乎不可能被完全殺死的存在。就像巫妖的靈魂被保存在命匣裏一樣，龍的生命精華可能會被保存在它最初出現的蛋裏、它的寶庫裏，或者世界中心的一個巨大洞穴裏。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的巫妖Lich。)

特殊感官Special Sense。大多數龍都有盲視和黑暗視覺。你可以將黑暗視覺升級爲真實視覺，或者你可以給一條有掘地速度的龍賦予顫動感知。(見《怪物圖鑑》的相關介紹）。)

掘道者Tunneler。任何具有掘地速度的龍都可以具有這種特性，即，在堅硬的岩石中移動，並在其後面挖出一條隧道。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的土巨怪umber hulk）。)

變體：龍類天生施法者Variant: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters

遠古綠龍天生可以施展法術，且不需任何材料成分。而該法術的環階也不能超過7階。 該龍的法術豁免DC等於 19，該龍的法術攻擊加值+11。

《怪物圖鑑》中關於讓龍成爲天生的施法者的變體規則是一種簡單的方法，可以在不影響龍的挑戰等級的情況下爲其增加多樣性。第5章爲不同種類的龍提供了建議的法術列表，但你也可以選擇法術來反映龍的特性。一條天生施展德魯伊法術的龍與施展術士法術的龍給人的感覺會截然不同。你也可以給龍提供比這個變體規則所允許的更高等級的法術，但這樣的調整可能會增加龍的挑戰等級——尤其是當這些法術能直接對目標造成傷害或施加各類增益/減益時。示例如下：

  • 隱身術  invisibility
  • 羣體暗示術  mass suggestion
  • 植物滋長  plant growth
  • 動物交談  speak with animals

Source: FTD

The most cunning and treacherous of true dragons, green dragons use misdirection and trickery to get the upper hand against their enemies. Nasty tempered and thoroughly evil, they take special pleasure in subverting and corrupting the good-hearted. In the ancient forests they roam, green dragons demonstrate an aggression that is often less about territory than it is about gaining power and wealth with as little effort as possible.

A green dragon is recognized by its curved jawline and the crest that begins near its eyes and continues down its spine, reaching full height just behind the skull. A green dragon has no external ears, but bears leathery spiked plates that run down the sides of its neck.

A wyrmling green dragon's thin scales are a shade of green so dark as to appear nearly black. As a green dragon ages, its scales grow larger and lighter, turning shades of forest, emerald, and olive green to help it blend in with its wooded surroundings. Its wings have a dappled pattern, darker near the leading edges and lighter toward the trailing edges.

A green dragon's legs are longer in relation to its body than with any other dragon, enabling it to easily pass over underbrush and forest debris when it walks. With its equally long neck, an older green dragon can peer over the tops of trees without rearing up.

Capricious Hunters. A green dragon hunts by patrolling its forest territory from the air and the ground. It eats any creature it can see, and will consume shrubs and small trees when hungry enough, but its favorite prey is elves.

Green dragons are consummate liars and masters of double talk. They favor intimidation of lesser creatures, but employ more subtle manipulations when dealing with other dragons. A green dragon attacks animals and monsters with no provocation, especially when dealing with potential threats to its territory. When dealing with sentient creatures, a green dragon demonstrates a lust for power that rivals its draconic desire for treasure, and it is always on the lookout for creatures that can help it further its ambitions.

A green dragon stalks its victims as it plans its assault, sometimes shadowing creatures for days. If a target is weak, the dragon enjoys the terror its appearance evokes before it attacks. It never slays all its foes, preferring to use intimidation to establish control over survivors. It then learns what it can about other creatures' activities near its territory, and about any treasure to be found nearby. Green dragons occasionally release prisoners if they can be ransomed. Otherwise, a creature must prove its value to the dragon daily or die.

Manipulative Schemers. A wily and subtle creature, a green dragon bends other creatures to its will by assessing and playing off their deepest desires. Any creature foolish enough to attempt to subdue a green dragon eventually realizes that the creature is only pretending to serve while it assesses its would-be master.

When manipulating other creatures, green dragons are honey-tongued, smooth, and sophisticated. Among their own kind, they are loud, crass, and rude, especially when dealing with dragons of the same age and status.

Conflict and Corruption. Green dragons sometimes clash with other dragons over territory where forest crosses over into other terrain. A green dragon typically pretends to back down, only to wait and watch-sometimes for decades-for the chance to slay the other dragon, then claim its lair and hoard.

Green dragons accept the servitude of sentient creatures such as goblinoids, ettercaps, ettins, kobolds, orcs, and yuan-ti. They also delight in corrupting and bending elves to their will. A green dragon sometimes wracks its minions' minds with fear to the point of insanity, with the fog that spreads throughout its forest reflecting those minions' tortured dreams.

Living Treasures. A green dragon's favored treasures are the sentient creatures it bends to its will, including significant figures such as popular heroes, well-known sages, and renowned bards. Among material treasures, a green dragon favors emeralds, wood carvings, musical instruments, and sculptures of humanoid subjects.

“I see an ancient elf king, his majesty long since faded, slumped and half asleep in his throne. A green dragon whispers in the king's ear, corrupting and twisting the king's dreams. This dragon's name is Cyan Bloodbane, and he means the destruction of us all.”

— Pelios of Ergoth, Silvanesti seer

A Green Dragon's Lair

The forest-loving green dragons sometimes compete for territory with black dragons in marshy woods and with white dragons in subarctic taiga. However, a forest controlled by a green dragon is easy to spot. A perpetual fog hangs in the air in a legendary green dragon's wood, carrying an acrid whiff of the creature's poison breath.

The moss-covered trees grow close together except where winding pathways trace their way like a maze into the heart of the forest. The light that reaches the forest floor carries an emerald green cast, and every sound seems muffled.

At the center of its forest, a green dragon chooses a cave in a sheer cliff or hillside for its lair, preferring an entrance hidden from prying eyes. Some seek out cave mouths concealed behind waterfalls, or partly submerged caverns that can be accessed through lakes or streams. Others conceal the entrances to their lairs with vegetation.

Chromatic Dragons

The black, blue, green, red, and white dragons represent the evil side of dragonkind. Aggressive, gluttonous, and vain, chromatic dragons are dark sages and powerful tyrants feared by all creatures-including each other.

Driven by Greed. Chromatic dragons lust after treasure, and this greed colors their every scheme and plot. They believe that the world's wealth belongs to them by right, and a chromatic dragon seizes that wealth without regard for the humanoids and other creatures that have "stolen" it. With its piles of coins, gleaming gems, and magic items, a dragon's hoard is the stuff of legend. However, chromatic dragons have no interest in commerce, amassing wealth for no other reason than to have it.

Creatures of Ego. Chromatic dragons are united by their sense of superiority, believing themselves the most powerful and worthy of all mortal creatures. When they interact with other creatures, it is only to further their own interests. They believe in their innate right to rule, and this belief is the cornerstone of every chromatic dragon's personality and worldview. Trying to humble a chromatic dragon is like trying to convince the wind to stop blowing. To these creatures, humanoids are animals, fit to serve as prey or beasts of burden, and wholly unworthy of respect.

Dangerous Lairs. A dragon's lair serves as the seat of its power and a vault for its treasure. With its innate toughness and tolerance for severe environmental effects, a dragon selects or builds a lair not for shelter but for defense, favoring multiple entrances and exits, and security for its hoard.

Most chromatic dragon lairs are hidden in dangerous and remote locations to prevent all but the most audacious mortals from reaching them. A black dragon might lair in the heart of a vast swamp, while a red dragon might claim the caldera of an active volcano. In addition to the natural defenses of their lairs, powerful chromatic dragons use magical guardians, traps, and subservient creatures to protect their treasures.

Queen of Evil Dragons. Tiamat the Dragon Queen is the chief deity of evil dragonkind. She dwells on Avernus, the first layer of the Nine Hells. As a lesser god, Tiamat has the power to grant spells to her worshipers, though she is loath to share her power. She epitomizes the avarice of evil dragons, believing that the multiverse and all its treasures will one day be hers and hers alone.

Tiamat is a gigantic dragon whose five heads reflect the forms of the chromatic dragons that worship her-black, blue, green, red, and white. She is a terror on the battlefield, capable of annihilating whole armies with her five breath weapons, her formidable spellcasting, and her fearsome claws.

Tiamat's most hated enemy is Bahamut the Platinum Dragon, with whom she shares control of the faith of dragonkind. She also holds a special enmity for Asmodeus, who long ago stripped her of the rule of Avernus and who continues to curb the Dragon Queen's power.

Dragons

True dragons are winged reptiles of ancient lineage and fearsome power. They are known and feared for their predatory cunning and greed, with the oldest dragons accounted as some of the most powerful creatures in the world. Dragons are also magical creatures whose innate power fuels their dreaded breath weapons and other preternatural abilities.

Many creatures, including wyverns and dragon turtles, have draconic blood. However, true dragons fall into the two broad categories of chromatic and metallic dragons. The black, blue, green, red, and white dragons are selfish, evil, and feared by all. The brass, bronze, copper, gold, and silver dragons are noble, good, and highly respected by the wise.

Though their goals and ideals vary tremendously, all true dragons covet wealth, hoarding mounds of coins and gathering gems, jewels, and magic items. Dragons with large hoards are loath to leave them for long, venturing out of their lairs only to patrol or feed.

True dragons pass through four distinct stages of life, from lowly wyrmlings to ancient dragons, which can live for over a thousand years. In that time, their might can become unrivaled and their hoards can grow beyond price.

Lair Actions

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the dragon takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; the dragon can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • Grasping roots and vines erupt in a 20-foot radius centered on a point on the ground that the dragon can see within 120 feet of it. That area becomes &Reference[rule=difficultterrain]{difficult terrain}, and each creature there must succeed on a [[/save ability=str dc=15]] saving throw or be &Reference[condition=restrained] by the roots and vines. A creature can be freed if it or another creature takes an action to make a [[/save ability=str dc=15]] check and succeeds. The roots and vines wilt away when the dragon uses this lair action again or when the dragon dies.
  • A wall of tangled brush bristling with thorns springs into existence on a solid surface within 120 feet of the dragon. The wall is up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick, and it blocks line of sight. When the wall appears, each creature in its area must make a [[/save ability=dex dc=15]] saving throw. A creature that fails the save takes 18 ([[/damage 4d8 type=piercing]]) damage and is pushed 5 feet out of the wall's space, appearing on whichever side of the wall it wants. A creature can move through the wall, albeit slowly and painfully. For every 1 foot a creature travels through the wall, it must spend 4 feet of movement. Furthermore, a creature in the wall's space must make a [[/save ability=dex dc=15]] saving throw once each round it's in contact with the wall, taking 18 ([[/damage 4d8 type=piercing]]) damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each 10-foot section of wall has AC 5, 15 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage, resistance to bludgeoning and piercing damage, and immunity to psychic damage. The wall sinks back into the ground when the dragon uses this lair action again or when the dragon dies.
  • Magical fog billows around one creature the dragon can see within 120 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=15]] saving throw or be &Reference[condition=charmed] by the dragon until initiative count 20 on the next round.

Additional Lair Actions. At your discretion, a legendary (@creature[Adult Green Dragon||adult] or @creature[Ancient Green Dragon||ancient]) green dragon can use one or both of the following additional lair actions while in its lair:

  • Creeper Vines. The dragon can use the vines and roots within its lair to animate up to three Humanoid corpses, which become @creature[Zombie||zombies]. The zombies take their turn immediately after this lair action. Each one reverts to an inanimate corpse after 1 minute, when the dragon uses this lair action again, or when the zombie is destroyed.

  • Lashing Root. One large root or branch that is part of the lair makes a melee attack roll against a creature within 10 feet of it. It has a +7 bonus to hit and deals 10 ([[/damage 3d6 type=bludgeoning]]) damage on a hit. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a [[/save ability=str dc=15]] saving throw or be knocked &Reference[condition=prone].

Regional Effects

The region containing a legendary green dragon's lair is warped by the dragon's magic, which creates one or more of the following effects:

  • Thickets form labyrinthine passages within 1 mile of the dragon's lair. The thickets act as 10-foot-high, 10-foot-thick walls that block line of sight. Creatures can move through the thickets, with every 1 foot a creature moves costing it 4 feet of movement. A creature in the thickets must make a [[/save ability=dex dc=15]] saving throw once each round it's in contact with the thickets or take 3 ([[/damage 1d6 type=piercing]]) damage from thorns.Each 10-foot-cube of thickets has AC 5, 30 hit points, resistance to bludgeoning and piercing damage, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to psychic and thunder damage.

  • Within 1 mile of its lair, the dragon leaves no physical evidence of its passage unless it wishes to. Tracking it there is impossible except by magical means. In addition, it ignores movement impediments and damage from plants in this area that are neither magical nor creatures, including the thickets described above. The plants remove themselves from the dragon's path.
  • Rodents and birds within 1 mile of the dragon's lair serve as the dragon's eyes and ears. Deer and other large game are strangely absent, hinting at the presence of an unnaturally hungry predator.

If the dragon dies, the rodents and birds lose their supernatural link to it. The thickets remain, but within [[/r 1d10]] days, they become mundane plants and normal &Reference[rule=difficultterrain]{difficult terrain}, losing their thorns.

Additional Regional Effects. Either or both of these effects might appear in the area around a green dragon's lair, in addition to or instead of those described in the Monster Manual:

  • Inviting Whispers. Whispers rustle in the foliage within 1 mile of the dragon's lair. The words are indistinct, but a creature with an Intelligence score of 5 or higher interprets them as an invitation to move deeper into the greenery.

  • Twisted Messengers. The dragon can cause any Tiny Beast within 1 mile of its lair to act as its mouthpiece. The effect is horrendous, as the creature's throat and mouth temporarily warp into a twisted version of the dragon's own in order to allow the dragon's voice to issue forth.

Customizing Dragons FTD p33[–]

You can customize any dragon's stat block to reflect the dragon's unique character. Minor changes such as those below are easy to make and have no impact on a dragon's challenge rating.

Languages. Most dragons prefer to speak Draconic but learn Common for dealing with allies and minions. But given their high Intelligence and long life span, dragons can easily learn additional languages. You can add languages to a dragon's stat block.

Skills. Most dragons are proficient in the Perception and Stealth skills, and many dragons have additional skill proficiencies. As with languages, you can customize a dragon's skill list (even doubling their proficiency bonus with certain skills) to reflect particular interests and activities. You can also give a dragon tool proficiencies, particularly if the dragon spends time in Humanoid form.

Spells. See the "Variant: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters" inset(s), below.

Other Traits and Actions. You can borrow traits and actions from other monsters to add unique flavor to a dragon. Consider these examples:

  • Flyby. The dragon is an agile flier, quick to fly out of enemies' reach.The dragon doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

  • Mimicry. Impersonating characters or their allies could be a fun trick for a crafty dragon.The dragon can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 19 Wisdom (Insight) check.

  • Rejuvenation. You might decide that dragons in your campaign, being an essential part of the Material Plane, are nearly impossible to destroy. A dragon's life essence might be preserved in the egg from which it first emerged, in its hoard, or in a cavernous hall at the center of the world, just as a lich's essence is hidden in a phylactery.If it has an essence-preserving object, a destroyed dragon gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the object.

  • Special Senses. Most dragons have blindsight and darkvision. You might upgrade blindsight to truesight, or you could give a dragon with a burrowing speed tremorsense.

Variant: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters[–]

This dragon can innately cast four spells, once per day each, requiring no material components. Each spell's level can be no higher than 7th. The dragon's spell save DC is DC 19, and it has +11 to hit with spell attacks.

A suggested spell list is shown below, but you can also choose spells to reflect the dragon's character. A dragon who innately casts druid spells feels different from one who casts warlock spells. You can also give a dragon spells of a higher level than this rule allows, but such a tweak might increase the dragon's challenge rating—especially if those spells deal damage or impose conditions on targets.

  • mass suggestion
  • plant growth

Variant: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters[–]

Dragons are innately magical creatures that can master a few spells as they age, using this variant.

A young or older dragon can innately cast a number of spells equal to its Charisma modifier. Each spell can be cast once per day, requiring no material components, and the spell's level can be no higher than one-third the dragon's challenge rating (rounded down). The dragon's bonus to hit with spell attacks is equal to its proficiency bonus + its Charisma bonus. The dragon's spell save DC equals 8 + its proficiency bonus + its Charisma modifier.

This dragon can innately cast four spells, once per day each, requiring no material components. Each spell's level can be no higher than 7th. The dragon's spell save DC is DC 19, and it has +11 to hit with spell attacks. See the spell page for a list of spells the dragon is capable of casting. A selection of examples are shown below:

  • project image
  • mirage arcane
  • prismatic spray
  • teleport

巢穴周邊1裏範圍內的樹叢形成了迷宮式的通道。此樹叢視爲10尺高、10尺厚，且能遮擋視線的牆壁。生物可以移動穿過該樹叢，其每移動1尺將花費4尺移動力。身處該樹叢內的生物如果接觸到樹叢，則每輪必須進行一次 [[/save ability=dex dc=15]]的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到3([[/damage 1d6 type=piercing]]) 點傷害。
  每10尺長的一段樹叢擁有AC 5，HP 30，鈍擊和穿刺傷害抗性，並且免疫心靈和雷鳴傷害。

綠龍可以在其巢穴周邊1裏範圍內，以自己意願選擇是否不帶任何物理痕跡的通過某個地點。除魔法以外的任何手段都無法追蹤到以此方式匿蹤的龍。此外，它還可以無視該區域內非魔法非生物的植物所造成的移動障礙和傷害，包括上述樹叢。這些植物會在該龍經過時自行避讓。

巢穴周圍1裏範圍內的齧齒動物和鳥類都可以充當龍的耳目。在區域內，大體型的獵物（比如鹿）十分稀少，暗示着飢餓的非自然捕食者正存在附近。

    龍死亡後，這些齧齒動物和鳥類將失去它們的超自然鏈接。樹叢得以保留着，不過會在 [[/r 1d10]] 日內逐漸變爲普通植物和正常的困難地形，並失去棘刺。

作爲《怪物圖鑑》所描述效應的追加或替代，以下這些效應中的一個或兩個都可能出現在綠龍巢穴周圍的區域：

邀人低語Inviting Whispers。綠龍巢穴周圍1英里範圍內的樹葉都會傳來陣陣低語聲。這些低語聽不清楚，但任何智力爲5或以上的生物都會將其解釋爲在邀請他們深入綠植之中。

異化信使Twisted Messengers。龍可以使其巢穴周圍1英里範圍內的任何小型野獸變成它的喉舌。如同字面意義將該生物的喉嚨與嘴巴扭曲成龍的怪異樣子，好發出龍的聲音。

The region containing a legendary green dragon's lair is warped by the dragon's magic, which creates one or more of the following effects:

  • Thickets form labyrinthine passages within 1 mile of the dragon's lair. The thickets act as 10-foot-high, 10-foot-thick walls that block line of sight. Creatures can move through the thickets, with every 1 foot a creature moves costing it 4 feet of movement. A creature in the thickets must make a [[/save ability=dex dc=15]] saving throw once each round it's in contact with the thickets or take 3 ([[/damage 1d6 type=piercing]]) damage from thorns.Each 10-foot-cube of thickets has AC 5, 30 hit points, resistance to bludgeoning and piercing damage, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to psychic and thunder damage.

  • Within 1 mile of its lair, the dragon leaves no physical evidence of its passage unless it wishes to. Tracking it there is impossible except by magical means. In addition, it ignores movement impediments and damage from plants in this area that are neither magical nor creatures, including the thickets described above. The plants remove themselves from the dragon's path.
  • Rodents and birds within 1 mile of the dragon's lair serve as the dragon's eyes and ears. Deer and other large game are strangely absent, hinting at the presence of an unnaturally hungry predator.

If the dragon dies, the rodents and birds lose their supernatural link to it. The thickets remain, but within [[/r 1d10]] days, they become mundane plants and normal &Reference[rule=difficultterrain]{difficult terrain}, losing their thorns.

Additional Regional Effects. Either or both of these effects might appear in the area around a green dragon's lair, in addition to or instead of those described in the Monster Manual:

  • Inviting Whispers. Whispers rustle in the foliage within 1 mile of the dragon's lair. The words are indistinct, but a creature with an Intelligence score of 5 or higher interprets them as an invitation to move deeper into the greenery.

  • Twisted Messengers. The dragon can cause any Tiny Beast within 1 mile of its lair to act as its mouthpiece. The effect is horrendous, as the creature's throat and mouth temporarily warp into a twisted version of the dragon's own in order to allow the dragon's voice to issue forth.

綠龍可以在空氣和水中呼吸。

The dragon can breathe air and water.

綠龍擁有3傳奇動作，用來選擇執行下列動作項。它每次只可選擇執行一個傳奇動作項，且必須在另一生物回合結束時執行。綠龍在其回合開始時恢復所有消耗的傳奇動作數。

  • 偵查@UUID[.jvpfNR2UH9TNsj2L]{Detect}
  • 尾擊攻擊@UUID[.kxDYl1l9xIUjlmfE]{Tail Attack}
  • 振翅攻擊@UUID[.peErgdkvFnLevNZi]{Wing Attack}

The dragon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The dragon regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

  • @UUID[.jvpfNR2UH9TNsj2L]{Detect}
  • @UUID[.kxDYl1l9xIUjlmfE]{Tail Attack}
  • @UUID[.peErgdkvFnLevNZi]{Wing Attack}

傳奇抗性Legendary Resistance（3/日）。綠龍豁免失敗時，可以將其改爲豁免成功。

If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

綠龍進行一次感知（察覺）(&Reference[skill=Perception])檢定。

The dragon makes a Wisdom (&Reference[skill=Perception]) check.

綠龍發動一次尾擊攻擊。

The dragon makes a tail attack.

items.name: 根鬚纏繞Grasping roots and vines erupt in a 20-foot radius ...

description.value:
先攻輪到20時（出現等值時視爲後手），該龍可執行一個巢穴動作併產生下列效應其一。它不能在連續兩輪裏重複使用同一種效應：

綠龍周邊120尺範圍內它能看見的一點長出糾纏的根鬚和藤蔓，並覆蓋以該點爲中心半徑20尺的區域。該區域變成困難地形，其中的每個生物都必須進行一次[[/save ability=str dc=15]]的力量豁免，豁免失敗者將受根鬚和藤蔓束縛&Reference[rule=difficultterrain]{difficult terrain}。任一生物（包括被束縛者本身）都可以用一個動作進行一次 [[/save ability=str dc=15]] 的力量豁免以解脫束縛。這條龍再此使用該巢穴動作，或其死亡時這些根鬚與藤蔓便開始枯萎消失。

Grasping roots and vines erupt in a 20-foot radius centered on a point on the ground that the dragon can see within 120 feet of it. That area becomes &Reference[rule=difficultterrain]{difficult terrain}, and each creature there must succeed on a [[/save ability=str dc=15]] saving throw or be &Reference[condition=restrained] by the roots and vines. A creature can be freed if it or another creature takes an action to make a [[/save ability=str dc=15]] check and succeeds. The roots and vines wilt away when the dragon uses this lair action again or when the dragon dies.

items.name: 魅惑濃霧Magical fog billows around one creature the dragon ...

description.value:
綠龍周邊120尺範圍內一個它能看見的生物周圍升起魔法的濃霧。該生物必須進行一次[[/save ability=wis dc=15]的感知豁免，豁免失敗則被該龍魅惑，效應持續至下一輪先攻輪到20。
Magical fog billows around one creature the dragon can see within 120 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=15]] saving throw or be &Reference[condition=charmed] by the dragon until initiative count 20 on the next round.

綠龍用藤蔓和根鬚將其巢穴內的最多三具類人屍骨活化爲殭屍Zombie@creature[Zombie||zombies]。這些殭屍們會在本巢穴動作之後立即行動。在1分鐘後，或是龍再度使用這個巢穴動作時，或是殭屍被消滅時，每個殭屍都將恢復爲無生命的屍體。

The dragon can use the vines and roots within its lair to animate up to three Humanoid corpses, which become @creature[Zombie||zombies]. The zombies take their turn immediately after this lair action. Each one reverts to an inanimate corpse after 1 minute, when the dragon uses this lair action again, or when the zombie is destroyed.

items.name: 荊棘之牆A wall of tangled brush bristling with thorns ...

description.value:
綠龍周邊120尺範圍內一處固態表面出現一面由帶刺荊棘糾纏而成的牆壁。該牆至多長60尺、高10尺、厚5尺，且可以遮擋視線。這面牆出現時，任何處於其區域內的生物都必須進行一次 [[/save ability=dex dc=15]]的敏捷豁免。豁免失敗者將受到18([[/damage 4d8 type=piercing]]) 點穿刺傷害，並被往牆外推出5尺落在牆壁的某一邊（由其自選）。生物可以緩慢而痛苦的以移動方式穿過該牆壁。生物在牆內每移動1尺必須花費4尺的移動力。此外，身處牆壁內的生物如果接觸到牆壁，則其每輪必須進行一次[[/save ability=dex dc=15]]的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到18 ([[/damage 4d8 type=piercing]])點穿刺傷害，豁免成功則傷害減半。每10尺長的一段牆擁有AC 5，HP 15，火焰傷害易傷，鈍擊和穿刺傷害抗性，並且免疫心靈傷害。這條龍再此使用該巢穴動作，或其死亡時這面牆便會縮回到地面之下。

A wall of tangled brush bristling with thorns springs into existence on a solid surface within 120 feet of the dragon. The wall is up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick, and it blocks line of sight. When the wall appears, each creature in its area must make a [[/save ability=dex dc=15]] saving throw. A creature that fails the save takes 18 ([[/damage 4d8 type=piercing]]) damage and is pushed 5 feet out of the wall's space, appearing on whichever side of the wall it wants. A creature can move through the wall, albeit slowly and painfully. For every 1 foot a creature travels through the wall, it must spend 4 feet of movement. Furthermore, a creature in the wall's space must make a [[/save ability=dex dc=15]] saving throw once each round it's in contact with the wall, taking 18 ([[/damage 4d8 type=piercing]]) damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each 10-foot section of wall has AC 5, 15 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage, resistance to bludgeoning and piercing damage, and immunity to psychic damage. The wall sinks back into the ground when the dragon uses this lair action again or when the dragon dies.

巢穴內一處大型樹根或枝條對其10尺內的單一生物進行近戰攻擊。其具有[[/r 1d20+7]]{+7}的命中加值，並造成10([[/damage 3d6 type=bludgeoning]]) 鈍擊傷害。如果目標生物的體型爲中等或更小，則必須成功通過一次 [[/save ability=str dc=15]]的力量豁免，否則受擊倒地&Reference[condition=prone]。

One large root or branch that is part of the lair makes a melee attack roll against a creature within 10 feet of it. It has a [[/r 1d20+7]]{+7}bonus to hit and deals 10 ([[/damage 3d6 type=bludgeoning]]) damage on a hit. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a [[/save ability=str dc=15]] saving throw or be knocked &Reference[condition=prone].
